question_cn: 2026 世界杯 B 组：瑞士 vs 加拿大（2026-06-24，温哥华）90 分钟赛果？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group B: Switzerland vs Canada (2026-06-24, Vancouver) — 90-minute result?
one_liner_cn: 瑞士阵容齐整小幅占优，但加拿大坐拥温哥华主场，三路概率接近，势均力敌的小组头名之争。
one_liner_en: Switzerland edge it on squad health and form, but Canada's Vancouver home advantage keeps this a near coin-flip for top spot in Group B.

key_reasons.cn: 加拿大伤病潮：主力中卫 Bombito 据报被移出名单，Flores 伤退由 Nelson 替补，Koné 训练中发烧离场。
key_reasons.en: Canada's injury wave: starting CB Bombito reportedly removed from the roster, Flores withdrew injured (Nelson called up), Kone left training with a fever.

key_reasons.cn: Davies 自 2025-03 ACL 撕裂后又两度腿筋受伤，出场存疑，但 6/10 已重返合练，距本场尚有约两周窗口。
key_reasons.en: Davies, after a March 2025 ACL tear and two hamstring setbacks, is a fitness doubt but returned to group training June 10, with about two weeks before this fixture.

key_reasons.cn: 瑞士 5/20 公布名单无重大伤病，Xhaka（145 次出场）领衔老将轴心，5/31 友谊赛 4-1 胜约旦，备战平稳。
key_reasons.en: Switzerland named a healthy 26-man squad May 20, led by Xhaka (145 caps), and warmed up with a 4-1 friendly win over Jordan on May 31.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7; +100 host bonus for Canada group match) gives 37.4/25.9/36.7; evidence-bounded adjustment +3.0/+0.5/-3.5pp (cap 8pp) for Canada injuries vs healthy Swiss squad; renormalized. No betting-market inputs of any kind.
